services.name: Tuna Fishing
services.desc: We believe we are one of the finest Snapper Fishing Charters in the Cocoa Beach, Florida area. In fact, if we had a forte', this would be it! Anglers love fishing for Snapper because they fight hard and are delicious to eat. On this fishing trip you and your group will target reef fish hanging around natural and artificial structure. We offer Cocoa Beach fishing charters for Mangrove, Lane, Vermillion Snapper & Red Snapper. This is an excellent fishing trip for families with smaller children. Call Get Down Charters today to bag some delicious Snapper on your next Port Canaveral Sportfishing Adventure! services.name: Sailfish Charters
services.desc: Sailfish Charters are a popular trip off Cocoa Beach, Florida. While sailfish are available year round, the best numbers occur during December and January. As winter approaches, Sailfish migrate South following schools of bait fish. The sailfish bite after a cold front during the winter months can be phenomenal.
